items.detail: All four sub-claims verified on merged main. (1) COMMIT: `git log -1 --format='%H'` => e942fd69b44dbfb13b7944c50c65123930761ab6, 'Merge branch wt/INT-CI-018' with parents bc829b6 + dfec1d4 — exact match. (2) DAEMON-SPECIFIC REASON: scripts/composed-mode-battery.py:312 `return f"docker daemon unavailable: {exc}"` (dfec1d4 changed it from 'docker info failed: {exc}'); TimeoutExpired subclasses subprocess.SubprocessError so it hits this branch. Confirmed in the merged tree, not just the branch: `git show HEAD:scripts/composed-mode-battery.py | sed -n 311,313p` => `return f"docker daemon unavailable: {exc}"`. Live simulation of a probe timeout produced reason = "docker daemon unavailable: Command '['docker', 'info']' timed out after 3 seconds", and _container_cells() propagated it into both UNAVAILABLE cells' failures, surfacing via main()'s `! {failure}` print at scripts/composed-mode-battery.py:483. (3) FOCUSED TEST: `/usr/bin/python3 -m pytest tests/test_composed_mode.py::TestCompositionBattery -x --tb=short -q` => "11 passed in 13.82s", exit 0. The new test test_docker_probe_timeout_reports_daemon_unavailable is a genuine regression test: reverting line 312 to the old string makes it FAIL with `assert 'docker daemon' in "docker info failed: Command '['docker', 'info']' timed out after 3 seconds"` at tests/test_composed_mode.py:492. Whole file: "21 passed, 3 skipped in 17.56s" (skips are live-docker cells). (4) RUFF: `ruff check .` => "All checks passed!", exit 0. (5) BOARD GUARD: `/usr/bin/python3 scripts/board_id_guard.py` => "OK: 364 rows, 364 unique ids", EXIT=0 (only advisory P2/P3 evidence warnings); guard tests tests/test_board_schema_guard.py + plugin/test_board_id_guard.py => "43 passed in 2.16s". Working tree clean apart from the .gitreins/tasks.yaml board row.
